literal.prompt: Какой географический полюс Земли имеет широту 90° северной широты?

literalGroups.primaryGround: NOAA defines the geographic graticule from 90°N at the North Pole to 90°S at the South Pole; AAP distinguishes true geographic poles from magnetic poles.
literalGroups.locator: NOAA L28; AAP L504 (heading True geographic pole and South magnetic pole)

literalGroups.literal: Это Северный полюс. Географическая широта этой точки равна 90° северной, а сам полюс находится в центре Северного Ледовитого океана.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NOAA identifies the North Pole as 90°N; NOAA PMEL places it in the central Arctic Ocean.
literalGroups.locator: NOAA L28; NOAA PMEL retained text L142,L214

literalGroups.literal: Южный географический полюс находится на 90° южной широты в Антарктиде.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NOAA labels the South Pole 90°S; AAP states the true south geographic pole is near Amundsen-Scott in Antarctica.

literalGroups.literal: Географический Северный полюс находится в центре Северного Ледовитого океана, который почти со всех сторон окружён сушей.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NOAA PMEL says the North Pole lies in the middle of the Arctic Ocean, surrounded by Alaska, Canada, Greenland and Russia. This adds a concrete location/context to the coordinate prompt.

literalGroups.literal: Магнитное направление на север обычно не совпадает с истинным севером; разницу между ними называют магнитным склонением.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AAP defines magnetic north as the compass direction under Earth magnetic field, distinguishes it from true north and names their difference magnetic declination.

literalGroups.literal: Положение Южного магнитного полюса меняется; в 2020 году его координаты были 64,07° ю. ш. и 135,88° в. д.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AAP says South Magnetic Pole moves about 5 km/year; its stated 2020 location is 64.07°S, 135.88°E. Decimal latitude is 64.07 degrees, not 64 degrees 7 minutes.

correctNoteNewFact.fact: The South Magnetic Pole moved about 5 km per year; in 2020 its full coordinate was 64.07°S, 135.88°E. The note states both coordinates in decimal form.
correctNoteNewFact.primaryLocator: AAP retained HTML actual stored line 504
correctNoteNewFact.correction: Prior note rendered 64°07′, a different value from source decimal 64.07°; corrected to 64,07° ю. ш. and 135,88° в. д.

entries.absoluteDifficulty: Easy is retained and well grounded: identifying the geographic North Pole as the location at 90°N is broad adult geography knowledge, not specialist polar science. Four choices are all real polar points and distinguishing geographic from magnetic poles requires simple standard map knowledge; this remains an easy factual recognition item.
